independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the gap between the legend and the fields (the collection gap) and the absent box.

intent: Name a set of related fields with a legend
Disable a set of fields together

properties.description: Disables every kit form control inside, at any depth, and nested fieldsets (their isDisabled reads it, as a native <fieldset disabled> would); data-disabled on the host and the legend. Disabled controls submit nothing.
The legend text; it names the group (aria-labelledby). An authored [data-part=legend] child takes its place and seeds it.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between the legend and the fields in u (0…8 in 0.5 steps); default the collection gap (theme gap-collection, 2u).

content.children: Fields (ui-field, ui-input, ui-select, choice groups, choices) and nested fieldsets; an optional authored [data-part=legend] child (any element, a heading too).

constraints: No native <fieldset> or <legend>: the host is role=group, named by its legend part through aria-labelledby. It is not form-associated; its controls submit their own values.

disabled reaches every kit form control inside at any depth: UIFormElement's isDisabled reads the nearest disabling container (ui-fieldset, ui-radio-group, ui-checkbox-group), and a nested fieldset is disabled with its outer one.
The legend is the title type role; a disabled fieldset fades it, and the controls fade themselves. The fieldset draws no box (padding, border, radius 0): put it in a card for a surface.

Composition: the legend may be authored as a [data-part=legend] child (a heading keeps its heading semantics); its text seeds legend, and the fieldset keeps it and gives it an id. React: Fieldset.Root (a native fieldset; disabled also reaches the kit hosts inside through context) and Fieldset.Legend (a div, as Base UI) as its direct child; the preset is Fieldset with a legend prop; both parts take render (an element or (props, state) => element) and className (a string or (state) => string).

avoidWhen.reason: A field names one control; a fieldset names a set.

avoidWhen.when: A set of radios or checkboxes that hold one value.
avoidWhen.reason: A choice group owns the value, name and validity; name it with a ui-field label (or put it in a fieldset with other fields).
A fieldset adds semantics and disabling, not a surface.

nodes.summary: The legend (Base UI Fieldset.Legend): title type role; its id is the group's aria-labelledby; data-disabled with the fieldset. Generated from legend or authored (any element); hidden when generated and empty.
